event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Mega-cap tech bounce, tape still sick.
Sept PPI printed 6.3% y/y vs 5.3% fc and 1.3% m/m vs 0.5% fc on Oct 15; that inflation shock explains this week's 200-DMA breakdowns, and today's +1.73% SOXX / +4.98% AMZN snap is short-covering inside a damaged tape, not a regime change.

INDICES — VIX 18.4, down with VIXY -4.06%; but VIX sits 2.5 points above its 15.9 20-day MA.
SOXX +1.73%, QQQ +1.21%, SPY +0.42%, IWM +0.31%, DIA -0.03%; large > small by 0.90pp. SPY and QQQ sit below their 200-DMAs — CTA sell trigger live. Biggest cross-asset move: TLT -0.74% and UUP +0.28%, bonds and dollar both leaning against equities.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Volume is tepid everywhere (indices avg 0.89x): QQQ 1.0x, SOXX 1.2x gaining attention, DIA 0.7x and RSP 0.7x ignored. SPY vol_ratio and QQQ vol_ratio near 1.0 with price up = low-conviction bounce, not accumulation. Breadth diverges hard: 182/315 advancers (37%), only 44% above the 50-DMA, 50% above the 200-DMA, up/down volume 0.82, 16 new highs vs 30 lows — participation does not confirm the mega-cap lift.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLY Discretionary +1.78%, XLK Technology +1.36%, XLB Materials +0.06%, XLC Comms -0.21%, XLP Staples -0.47%, XLV Healthcare -0.60%, XLI Industrials -0.64%, XLE Energy -0.64%, XLF Financials -0.83%, XLRE Real Estate -1.16%, XLU Utilities -2.01%.
Top industries DRAM +4.05% and XBI +2.45%; bottom UTES -2.06% and MSOS -2.06%. Flows contradict price: XLE +406mm (73p) and XLV +367mm (85p) saw the biggest 5-day inflows while XLK bled -235mm (15p) and XLF -253mm (42p). Money is moving out of tech and financials into energy, healthcare and staples — defensive risk-off with a one-day mega-cap squeeze on top.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.34 and IWM 1.78 = real protection demand; QQQ skew +14.4% and ATM IV 24.1% price crash risk in tech. VIXEQ 40.9 vs VIX 18.4 — a 22.5-point gap means extreme single-stock dispersion and a rotation tape. VVIX 106.9 vs 89.9 MA says vol-of-vol is bid; dealers are not complacent.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -0.61% and silver +0.06% despite a flat dollar (UUP +0.28%) is unusual — metals aren't hedging the equity bounce, and TLT -0.74% says duration is still the funding short. Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 78% for a 25bp HIKE at the December meeting vs 20% no-change — a hawkish tail the equity bounce is ignoring.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 59.5, Neutral.
Movers: AMZN +4.98% (headline is a Friday -1.9% print, no fresh catalyst), PLTR +4.36% (Friday -7.2%, so a dead-cat bounce), MRVL +4.06% on the Microsoft/Oracle data-center security group. 20d momentum: XLE +8.55% best sector, XLK -4.56% worst; SOXX -10.26% worst basket. Vol spikes: PYPL 2.3x at -0.34% and MSCI 2.3x at -0.98% — distribution, not accumulation.
Watch tomorrow: SOXX (+1.73%, 20d -10.26%, 5d flows -1,110mm at 4th percentile — bounce on no money), GLD (-0.61%, GEX flip 395 above spot, +841mm inflow — coiled), IWM (+0.31%, PCR 1.78 — heavy hedging into a 5d -2.38% slide).
